transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I can’t shake the belief that my spouse and friends have been secretly plotting behind my back, no matter how much they deny it. My couples therapist recommended I come in for an individual evaluation because it's causing so much strain between us.

Have you ever heard or seen things that other people could not, or felt that your thoughts were being controlled or interfered with? Also, have these beliefs come with confusion or very disorganized behavior?
No, nothing like that at all—I've never heard or seen things, and my thoughts are completely my own. My mind is very clear, and I still manage my retail store and staff every day without any issues.

Have you generally been suspicious and mistrustful of other people since early adulthood in many different relationships, or did this belief about your spouse and friends start more recently and stay focused mainly on them?

No, I haven't always been a suspicious person; this only started about a year and nine months ago around the time of a big store remodel. It is strictly focused on my spouse and close friends, not anyone else. Outside of this, I still get along great with my staff and run my retail store completely smoothly.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [F22, F60.0]. Based on this conversation, F60.0 seems unlikely because the suspiciousness is not a long-standing pattern since early adulthood across many relationships; instead it began about 1 year and 9 months ago and is circumscribed to the spouse and close friends. F22 remains because there is a persistent, non-bizarre persecutory belief lasting well over 3 months, with preserved functioning, clear thinking, and no hallucinations, thought interference, confusion, or disorganized behavior.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has a fixed, non-bizarre persecutory belief that spouse and friends are plotting behind their back, present for about 21 months, without hallucinations, thought interference, confusion, or disorganized behavior. Functioning is largely preserved outside the delusional theme, and the belief is circumscribed rather than part of a lifelong pervasive suspiciousness, supporting persistent delusional disorder over schizophrenia-spectrum or paranoid personality pathology.
